responsibility: This subtarget header adapts the generic m68k backend to a System V Release 4–style ELF ABI. It sets assembler syntax details, switch-table emission, alignment and common/BSS output, structure-return and static-chain registers, debugger register numbering, and start/end file specs, thereby providing the ELF/SVR4 ABI conventions that sit between generic m68k code generation and System V toolchain expectations.
